note: Canonical estate manifest. Membership follows Daniel's rulings of 2026-08-02: every Patter* repository, plus WiseWattage, AutoWatt and Guth. governed is true only for the three seeded ventures; every other row is an inventory row that the quarterly estate review asks adopt or defer about. Every row below was read read-only on 2026-08-03; nothing was written into any sibling repository. estate/ESTATE_MAP.md is the human narrative of this file and does not restate membership. The v1 YAML manifest is archived at archive/v1/estate/repos.yaml.

PatterTech_EOS.role: The engineering operating system: the shared knowledge and process brain that seeds and governs the ventures. No build.
owns: The knowledge packs and the pack contract
The kernel: policy, guard and metadata law, schemas and seed templates
The registries and the evidence ledger
This estate manifest and the governance layer
does_not_own: Any runnable product or venture code
Runtime services, which are PatterStack inside PatterStudio
Design-system code, which lives in PatterTech_Website
PatterTech_EOS.agent_files: AGENTS.md plus a byte-identical CLAUDE.md, enforced by check E003
PatterTech_EOS.notes: Not a governed venture and not a candidate: it is the manifest's own home, which is why status is self rather than candidate. Branch feat/eos-v2-agentic-development, the v2 integration branch.

AutoWatt.role: A UK lifecycle-integrity platform for renewable-energy assets: the authoritative record of an installation, projected to owners, O&M stewards, admins and the public.
AutoWatt.stack: FastAPI on Python 3.12 over Postgres 16 with S3 or MinIO evidence storage, two Next.js surfaces, local-first via Docker
owns: The record core and the single authorisation choke point
Its own product app, marketing site and public QR surfaces
Its own governance tree under org/
does_not_own: The kernel it was seeded from
AutoWatt.notes: Seeded venture, L scale, Genesis in progress. No git remote is configured locally, so nothing here is pushed anywhere; branch main, last commit 2026-07-17. Its seed pack is the extraction source for kernel/templates/, and its route to v2 is recompile rather than upgrade.

Guth.role: A browser-first, local-only practice instrument for a blocked singer: graded evaluative exposure, measured without flattery. A personal venture, never for commercial release.
owns: Its Studio and Stage modes and the Confidence Ladder measurement
Its own governance tree under org/ and its lock-book
does_not_own: The kernel it was seeded from
Guth.eos_pin: recorded as v1.0.0 @ 3807eb1, which is not the v1.0.0 tag; see registry/PROJECTS.md
Guth.notes: Seeded venture, M scale, S0 gate passed 2026-07-15 and Genesis complete. Branch main, last commit 2026-07-16. The directory is Project_Guth; the canonical venture name is Guth.

PatterTech_Website.role: The public marketing and publishing site: the company, its principles, and the venture directory. A static Next.js export on Vercel.
PatterTech_Website.stack: Next.js App Router with static export, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, no backend
owns: Public publishing and rendering of the marketing site and research documents
The V2 document model, the field kit, the dev-only visual editor and the visual media capability, until WebKit extracts them
does_not_own: Print and investor documents, which are PatterStudio's
Design doctrine, which is the EOS's
Accounts, gated content, mailing list and analytics, which are PatterTech_App's
PatterTech_Website.agent_files: AGENTS.md plus a byte-identical CLAUDE.md, enforced by its own lint script
PatterTech_Website.notes: Governed but never compiled from the EOS: it predates it, and its v0.1 lock-in lives in its own design-system document. Live and public. Branch feat/foundations-pass, last commit 2026-07-27. It aligns to a compiled S seed when the current foundations work settles.

WiseWattage.role: Energy modelling and optimisation for sites with solar, storage and grid: an installable Python library plus a live SaaS around it.
WiseWattage.stack: Python with a Polars-first pipeline, a FastAPI and Next.js application layer, Postgres, hosted on Railway and Vercel
owns: Its energy optimisers and the site analysis tool
Its own auth, billing and hosting
WiseWattage.notes: The estate's exemplar tenant and the source of most vendor rows in registry/VENDORS.md. Live with real users. Branch dev, last commit 2026-07-20. Adopt or defer at the quarterly estate review; it is the strongest adoption candidate because it already carries the practices.

PatterStudio.role: The deterministic document factory for investor and marketing material, and the home of PatterStack, the shared service fabric.
PatterStudio.stack: Python with uv, a LangGraph orchestrator, an MCP toolbox, Postgres with pgvector, plus one Next.js application
owns: Print and investor document generation through the deterministic build
PatterStack, the runtime fabric
The canonical patter-doc asset-pack document model
does_not_own: Web article rendering, which is PatterTech_Website's web profile of patter-doc
interacts_with: PatterTech_Website borrows the Cherenkov brand tokens as a hand port and renders the capture media PatterStudio references
PatterStudio.notes: The directory name and the remote name differ: PatterStudio on disk, PatterTech_Business on GitHub. Live. Branch content/philosophy-02-era-fix, last commit 2026-07-25.

PatterStage.role: An open-source web control plane and orchestrator for agent runs: dispatch missions, schedule recurring work, browse sessions and memory, manage models and profiles.
PatterStage.stack: Web application over SQLite, talking to the agent runtime through one HTTP adapter
owns: The agent control plane, its exactly-once scheduler and its graph semantics
does_not_own: The agent runtime it drives, which is a third-party dependency
The shared run engine it intends to consume from PatterStack
PatterStage.notes: Public and open source with a few users. Formerly named hermes-control-hub. Branch dev, last commit 2026-07-27.

PatterOS.role: The local-first base: hardware build guides, provisioner and installer scripts for a budget local-AI workstation, plus the sovereignty charter and the reserved marks.
owns: The bare-metal build guide, the provisioner and the local-first base layer
The Operation Level Playing Field manifesto and the reserved Patter marks and Cherenkov brand
PatterOS.notes: Public under Apache-2.0. Dormant: branch dev, last commit 2026-06-18. It is the reason the hardware domain stays registry-only in registry/coverage.json, since a dormant pre-EOS repo cannot demand doctrine.

PatterHome.role: A self-hosted, local-first family operating system: one household, one always-on machine, one SQLite database. People and network, cookbook, budget planner.
PatterHome.stack: Python backend with Alembic migrations over SQLite, plus a web frontend, packaged with Docker
owns: The household platform: accounts, capability permissions, quick capture, permission-aware search and the backup subsystem where restore is the acceptance test
PatterHome.notes: Planning stage by its own README, though the tree already holds source, migrations and tests. No git remote is configured locally. Branch main, last commit 2026-08-03, which makes it the most active unowned repo in the estate and the strongest argument for the quarterly adopt-or-defer review.

PatterPower.role: The planning and architecture blueprint for PatterPowerOS, the control layer for co-located clean-energy parks. A decision-grade plan, not the platform.
owns: The technical, operational, commercial and regulatory blueprint for the energy-park venture
Its business plan, financial model and investor material
does_not_own: Any running platform; nothing here is deployed
PatterPower.notes: Documents and schema sketches rather than a product. No git remote is configured locally. Branch platform-blueprint, last commit 2026-07-04. It carries commercial and regulatory material that no EOS pack covers, which is why business-model-pricing-and-operations and legal-licensing-and-compliance-routing are Wave B rows.

PatterTech_App.role: The out-of-band business platform and the estate data spine: the canonical subscriber record and the append-only consent ledger the static sites cannot hold.
PatterTech_App.stack: FastAPI and Postgres run locally through Docker Compose
owns: The data spine: organisation, venture and project, the subscriber record and the consent ledger
Later: accounts, the self-hosted mailing list, lead capture, gated content and analytics
does_not_own: The public marketing site, which stays a pure static client
Sending reputation, mailbox security and hosted auth, which are all rented
PatterTech_App.notes: Dormant by its own README: a local-only scaffold, deployed nowhere, awaiting a reactivation runbook. Branch feat/data-spine, last commit 2026-07-08. Its README states there is no git remote, but one is configured; that line is stale and belongs to its own repo to fix, not ours.

PatterTech_WebKit.role: The shared web design system, field kit, document model and dev-only editor, to be extracted from PatterTech_Website and distributed as a copy-in registry.
owns: The design-system code, the field kit, the editor and the visual media capability, reusable across future sites
PatterTech_WebKit.notes: Planned, not created. No directory exists on disk and no commit has been made. It carries no path for that reason. Recorded here because the extraction it names is a live intention inside PatterTech_Website, and dropping the row would hide that.
